largītĭōnālis , e, adj. largitio, II.,
I.of or belonging to the imperial treasury: officiales, treasury-officers, masters of the treasury, Cod. Th. 12, 6, 13; also subst.: largī-tĭōnālis , is, m., a treasury-officer, Vop. Carin. 19.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
